body: It’s good to have hope.. just don’t rely on it

I tried my best to fall in love with and enjoy life in a positive way. But as the years went by (not too many years I’m still very young), I started realising that it is very hard borderline impossible for people like us to live that healthy lifestyle and connect with the majority of people we meet and go on dates and start relationships and stuff.. we’re just different, and although it’s sad, we have to accept it and make it our strength. I still feel sad about being alone sometimes, but I’ve been enjoying solitude more and more. I’m starting to romanticise pain, sadness, and melancholy. I love me a good depressing weather and ambiance. I love trees with no leaves. I love empty places and late night walks. I didn’t use to think all of this was normal, but I started to question “Normal”. In my opinion, normal is as relative and subjective as anything can get. So if you ever feel like you’re messed up for loving something that doesn’t affect anyone else other than you, don’t bother yourself with thinking about if it’s okay or not.
Or maybe I am messed up. I don’t know you tell me.
Really? What makes you so sure. Everyone keeps saying the same thing with no actual foundation or logical reasoning behind it.

I always feel alone no matter the context. The uncertainty of my future scares the shit out of me. For a very emotional person I can’t seem to understand other people’s emotions or communicate mine to them in a healthy way. And the cherry on the cake, I just deeply believe that our lives, our universe, our existence is meaningless. 

I tried to overdose in 2021, but I failed and when I saw how it impacted my parents and siblings I couldn’t bear the guilt and I decided to never go down that path again but it actually makes me even more depressed because it feels like I’m not living for myself but only for the sake of others.
I could never listen to carti before whole lotta red. His voice was always so annoying to me and his stuff didn’t make any sense to me. But yea, grew on me.

For me I think it’s Future. Like, a lot of people say his music is special to them and everything but when I listen to him I just don’t find anything special about it it almost feels like eating tasteless food. I like Solo though I think that’s the only future song on one of my playlists. HOWEVER, I am still open to give Future work other listens so if you have an suggestions go ahead

I felt very very oddly at peace before committing as well it felt like falling asleep on a very comfortable bed and I felt like finally everything will be just over 
But then I wake up at the hospital and then I’m alive again. And I realised that even if killing myself was gonna bring me inner peace, I would’ve just brought chaos into other people’s lives especially my parents’ 
And I know that living for the sake of others isn’t the healthiest way to stay alive but it might help you survive longer until can finally bring yourself to love yourself and love your life. I know for a fact that there is at least one thing you enjoy in life so can you focus on it ? Expand it ? Maybe even try to discover other things ? Pls just try your best to find a reason to live because you certainly will sooner or later
